material.why: Bambu PETG, declared as cad-agent's 'petg-bambu-basic'. The print plan uses Bambu PETG HF (cad/turret_print.py FILAMENT['petg']) and the catalogue lists PETG Basic (catalog/materials.json 'petg'); Basic's two data-sheet editions bound HF on all three quantities the check uses (allowable strain 1.28 % against 1.30 % along the layers, mating modulus 2780 against 1810 MPa, retention modulus 1460 against 1810 MPa), so a pass holds for either spool.

friction.source: Covestro, Snap-Fit Joints for Plastics - A Design Guide, Table 3 (cad-agent research/compliant-mechanisms.md section 4): PETG is not listed; PBT, its polyester neighbour, is 0.35-0.40 against steel; low = 0.35, high = 0.40 x 1.5 (the table's same-material factor for PP, POM and PA)

print.how: upside down: the tongues lie in the bed plane; it stands on the flap's hinge lugs, 7 mm proud of the disc, so the disc and the latches print on supports (cad/turret_print.py); the barbs' return faces overhang 30 deg from the vertical

catch_print.how: standing on its bottom rim and the baffle: the ridges' undersides overhang 30 deg from the vertical

hopper_lid.cycles_basis: opened for every manual refill: about 5 a day of play, 200 days a year, 2 years (est)

load.case: R-fall sideways (forward fall) at the -25 deg tilt stop
load.source: cad/turret_studies.py R-fall (FALL_G 30, the TM design load of docs/cad-plan.md section 5); the hopper axis leans 25 deg at the stop (cad/turret.py tilt_min)

curved_beam.basis: Castigliano, circular cantilever with a radial tip load (r_mid = the hopper wall + TONGUE_N + h / 2)

checks.detail: every cad-agent row of both declarations passes (root strain, root radius, retention at the low bound, mating at the high bound)
3 x 4.96 N (friction 0.35, the lowest data-sheet modulus) vs 11.93 N = 1.2 x 9.94 N
3 x 14.63 N (friction 0.6, the highest data-sheet modulus, return 30 deg) vs 50 N by hand
3 x 14.63 N (lead 30 deg) vs 50 N by hand

checks.check: barb and ridge, shear across the layers
tongue bent out of its plane
checks.detail: 6 x 14.63 N x 27.5 / (3 x 8.58^2) = 10.92 MPa along the layers vs 29 / 2 (SF 2)
the backing (4 deep) still reaches s 1.968 when the barb tops the ridge (lift 2.032); the contact is at s 1.900

catch_print.how: on its back, the open face up: the ridges' back faces overhang 30 deg from the vertical

board_bay_lid.cycles_basis: opened for board service and bring-up: about 100 over the turret's life (est)
